notes.title: Axis Football 2018 First Update
notes.notes:
Folks,

Thanks so much for a great release! Day 1 has been awesome! You guys have provided a ton of great feedback. I want to ensure you that we take that feedback seriously. To that end, we will be pushing an update tonight with some adjustments and fixes for some items that popped up today.

You guys purchased this game and deserve it to be the best experience we can provide, so we're going to work to make that happen.

I'll be back with some official patch notes in just a bit.

Best,

-Danny
